# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables & assignment
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bare names are TEMP by default; a leading `&` marks a persistent variable.
set_variable = { current_year = 2026 }
add_to_variable = { current_year = 1 }
subtract_from_variable = { current_year = 1 }

set_temp_variable = { century = 50 }
multiply_temp_variable = { century = 4 }
divide_temp_variable = { century = 2 }

add_to_variable = { current_year = century }
subtract_from_variable = { current_year = 100 }

# `null` clears a persistent variable from memory.
set_variable = { scratch = 7 }
clear_variable = scratch

# Tuple assignment: one statement per pair, each by its own `&` marker.
set_variable = { budget = 100 }
set_temp_variable = { rand_min = 26 }
set_temp_variable = { rand_max = 30 }


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Arithmetic expressions (operator precedence, parentheses, math builtins)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full C-like precedence: ** > * / % > + -. Parentheses override it. The whole
# tree compiles to one nested accumulator value-block — no temp scaffolding.
set_temp_variable = {
	a = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = 2
			multiply = 3
		}
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	b = {
		value = {
			value = 1
			add = 2
		}
		multiply = 3
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	c = {
		value = 2
		pow = {
			value = 3
			pow = 2
		}
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	d = {
		value = 17
		mod = 5
	}
}

# Builtins: sqrt(x), round(x), clamp(x, lo, hi), abs(x).
set_temp_variable = {
	hyp = {
		value = {
			value = {
				value = a
				pow = 2
			}
			add = {
				value = b
				pow = 2
			}
		}
		root = 2
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	score = {
		value = {
			value = {
				value = c
				divide = 10
			}
			round = yes
		}
		clamp = {
			min = 0
			max = 50
		}
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	dist = {
		value = {
			value = a
			subtract = b
		}
		multiply = {
			value = {
				value = a
				subtract = b
			}
			greater_than = 0
			multiply = 2
			subtract = 1
		}
	}
}

# Line continuations: a trailing operator (or an explicit `\`) joins the next
# physical line into one logical expression. Indentation on the continuation
# line is ignored — useful for long formulas.
set_temp_variable = {
	f = {
		value = {
			value = {
				value = 1.5
				multiply = {
					value = mtth:democracy_factor
					add = mtth:fascism_factor
				}
			}
			divide = {
				value = {
					value = {
						value = 2
						multiply = mtth:democracy_factor
					}
					add = mtth:communism_factor
				}
				add = mtth:fascism_factor
			}
		}
		multiply = 2
	}
}
set_temp_variable = {
	g = {
		value = {
			value = {
				value = 10
				add = 20
			}
			add = 30
		}
		add = 40
	}
}

# Random builtins. randi/randf write into a variable; the max bound is
# inclusive. rand(v) uses the engine's default range. `var = randi(lo, hi)` is
# sugar for randi(var, lo, hi).
set_temp_variable_to_random = { var=luck min=1 max=7 integer=yes }
set_variable_to_random = { var=seed min=0 max=101 integer=yes }
set_temp_variable_to_random = { var=spread min=0.0 max=1.0 }
set_temp_variable_to_random = chaos


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conditionals: if / elif / else
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if = {
	limit = {
		check_variable = { current_year > 2025 }
	}
	log = "current_year ([?current_year]) is after 2025"
}
else_if = {
	limit = {
		check_variable = { current_year < 2025 }
	}
	log = "current_year ([?current_year]) is before 2025"
}
else = { log = "current_year ([?current_year]) is exactly 2025" }

# `== null` tests variable existence.
clear_variable = current_year
if = {
	limit = {
		NOT = { has_variable = current_year }
	}
	log = "current_year was cleared"
}

# Boolean operators: and / or / not, with parentheses.
# Comparisons >= / <= / != emit the long check_variable form (the infix
# engine form only supports =, >, <).
if = {
	limit = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				check_variable = { var=current_year value=1939 compare=greater_than_or_equals }
				check_variable = { current_year < 1945 }
			}
			check_variable = { current_year = 1945 }
		}
	}
	log = "WWII is ongoing"
}
if = {
	limit = {
		NOT = { is_historical_focus_on = yes }
	}
	log = "Ahistorical mode"
}
if = {
	limit = {
		check_variable = { var=enemies_count value=0 compare=not_equals }
	}
	log = "Has enemies"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# match / case (compiles to if / else_if / else)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Multiple patterns per arm via `|`; `case _` is the default.
if = {
	limit = {
		OR = {
			check_variable = { rival_ideology = conservatism }
			check_variable = { rival_ideology = liberalism }
			check_variable = { rival_ideology = socialism }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pop = party_popularity@democratic }
}
else_if = {
	limit = {
		OR = {
			check_variable = { rival_ideology = fascism }
			check_variable = { rival_ideology = nazism }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pop = party_popularity@fascism }
}
else_if = {
	limit = {
		check_variable = { rival_ideology = neutrality }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { pop = party_popularity@neutrality }
}
else = {
	set_temp_variable = { pop = 0 }
}

	log = "step [?j]"

# while runs its body until the condition (a limit trigger) fails.

		check_variable = { enemies^num < 4 }

}

# resize(n) pads with 0 (or truncates); resize(n, v) pads with a given value.

# `scope->trigger(arg)` and prefixed engine refs (var: / token: / mtth:).
if = {
	limit = {
		THIS = { has_war_with = FROM }
	}
	log = "At war with FROM"
}

# A country tag can lead a scope transition the same way.
if = {
	limit = {
		GER = { has_war_with = ROOT }
	}
	log = "Germany is at war with us"
}

# Multi-level chains nest each scope: A->B->C(x) => A = { B = { C = x } }.
PREV = {
	any_controlled_state = { is_on_continent = south_america }
}

# `scope->name:` opens a nested block inside that scope transition.
FROM = {
	every_owned_state = { add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 }
}

# "any of" / "all of" sugar: `|` expands to OR, `&` to AND, repeating the
# trigger for each value.
if = {
	limit = {
		OR = {
			has_country_leader_ideology = despotism
			has_country_leader_ideology = oligarchism
		}
	}
	log = "Despotic or oligarchic leader"
}

		has_idea = idea_a
		has_idea = idea_b
	}
	log = "Has both ideas"
}

# Scorer effects. A temp target (default) selects the _temp engine variant; a
# persistent (`&`) target the plain one. For sorted, the output array and the
# optional scores array must share a lifetime.
get_highest_scored_country_temp = { scorer=democratic_scorer var=largest_democracy }
get_sorted_scored_countries = { scorer=democratic_scorer array=democracies scores=democracy_scores }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Macros (compile-time expansion; defaults and optional params supported)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define BEFORE any call — the transformer registers macros top-to-bottom.

add_stability = 0.05
add_war_support = 0.05

# `scope->$macro(args)` expands the macro body inside that scope transition.
FROM = {
	add_stability = 0.02
	add_war_support = 0.02
}
FRA = {
	add_stability = 0.01
	add_war_support = 0.01
}

# Optional params via `if defined(_p_):` — resolved at expansion time against
# what the CALLER actually passed (defaults don't count). Kept and spliced
# inline if every named param was supplied, dropped entirely otherwise.
# `{param}` interpolates inside an identifier (word-boundary sub can't).

add_timed_idea = { idea = idea_ENG_boost }

	idea = idea_ENG_boost
	days = 90
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LINQ-style iteration with filtering
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# for x in scope(): iterate a country scope; .which(cond) filters it.
every_country = {
	random_other_country = {
		limit = {
			is_major = yes
			NOT = { has_government = PREV }
		}
		add_to_array = { PREV.rivals = THIS }
	}
}

# Indexed array iteration: `for value, index in arr[]:` (use _ to drop index).
for_each_loop = {
	array = enemies
	value = foe
	index = idx
	log = "enemy [?idx]: [?foe]"
}

# `break` leaves the loop: the compiler declares a unique flag in the loop
# header and sets it here. Works inside nested ifs; nested loops get separate
# flags.
for_each_loop = {
	array = enemies
	value = foe
	index = idx
	break = hsl_break1
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { foe = USA }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { found_at = idx }
		set_temp_variable = { hsl_break1 = 1 }
	}
}
